items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He had been to New York and was a little discouraged. I said, "Come on back."

ctx.x: on a vacation. By the way, we're both from Pittsburgh. He had been to New York and was a little discouraged. I said, "Come on back." So he came back later on, his girl friend or someone brought him here. Moe Ash heard Erroll Garner and he said, "Mary, try to get Errd1 Garner and Art Tatum to record." I knew Errd1 Garner needed money. I said, "I think it will cost you about $1500 for Art Tatum; $750 for Errd1." He said, "I don't care; I'll pay them. Get them." Moe Ash was so great that when I talked with Art…
But after you made the records for Moe did they get out much? Was there much circulation?
